title: Play music at will
features:
Music Player Script - Rayfield UI

A feature-rich in-game music player with clean interface. Search any song by name, browse results, and play with one click. Includes playback controls: play/pause, stop, and loop mode. All music streams smoothly through local download system. Built with Rayfield Interface Suite for intuitive user experience. Simply enter song name, select from list, and enjoy seamless playback. Perfect for enhancing your Roblox gaming experience with personalized music.
